function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The Ultimate Guide to Men’s Underwear Styles *(What they’re called, how they feel, when to wear them, and what to look for when buying)* | Style | What It Looks Like | Key Features | Best For | Typical Materials | |-------|--------------------|--------------|----------|-------------------| | **Briefs** | Classic “T‑shirt” cut, high waist, snug fit | Full coverage, firm support, minimal leg exposure | Everyday wear, office, casual | Cotton, modal, microfiber, spandex blends | | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines briefs and boxers: longer leg coverage, elastic waistband | Full coverage, supportive, less restrictive than briefs | Everyday, gym, travel | Cotton, polyester, spandex, bamboo | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑leg cut, low waist | Breathable, relaxed fit, minimal support | Sleep, lounging, casual | Cotton, linen, modal | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer briefs, higher cut | Sporty, supportive, less bulk | Gym, running, active wear | Polyester, nylon, spandex | | **Thongs** | Minimal rear coverage, waistband at hips | Zero‑visible line, minimal bulk | Formal events, hot weather, beach | Nylon, polyester, spandex | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive front pouch, waistband, minimal rear | Athletic support, minimal coverage | Sports, cycling, bodybuilding | Nylon, polyester, spandex | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, full‑coverage, often with built‑in support | Muscle support, sweat‑wicking | Running, cycling, weightlifting | Polyester, nylon, spandex | | **Bamboo Underwear** | Usually boxer briefs or trunks | Eco‑friendly, moisture‑wicking, soft | Everyday, eco‑conscious shoppers | Bamboo fiber blends | | **Modal Underwear** | Soft, silky feel | Breathable, moisture‑wicking, less prone to pilling | Everyday, sensitive skin | Modal blends | | **Performance Tech** | Often boxer briefs or trunks | Advanced moisture management, anti‑odor | Athletes, hot climates | Technical fabrics (polyester, nylon, spandex) | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style | Question | What to Look For | |----------|------------------| | **What’s your daily activity level?** | • **Low** → Boxers or briefs for breathability.
• **Medium** → Boxer briefs or trunks for support.
• **High** → Compression shorts or performance tech. | | **Do you have sensitive skin or allergies?** | • Opt for natural fibers (cotton, modal, bamboo).
• Avoid synthetic blends if you’re prone to irritation. | | **Will you be wearing it under tight clothing?** | • Choose briefs or boxer briefs for a smooth silhouette.
• Thongs or jockstraps only if you’re comfortable with minimal coverage. | | **Do you travel often?** | • Look for wrinkle‑resistant, quick‑dry fabrics.
• Trunks or boxer briefs are compact and easy to pack. | | **What’s your budget?** | • **Low** → Basic cotton briefs or boxers.
• **Mid** → Performance blends or bamboo.
• **High** → Premium technical fabrics or designer labels. | --- ## Quick‑Reference Cheat Sheet | Situation | Recommended Style | Why | |-----------|-------------------|-----| | **Office / Formal** | Briefs or boxer briefs | Keeps a clean line under suits. | | **Gym / Running** | Compression shorts or performance boxer briefs | Supports muscles, wicks sweat. | | **Travel** | Trunks or boxer briefs | Compact, easy to pack, versatile. | | **Hot Weather** | Thongs or bamboo boxer briefs | Breathable, minimal bulk. | | **Sleep / Lounging** | Boxers or modal briefs | Relaxed fit, breathable. | | **Cycling** | Jockstrap or compression shorts | Provides support, reduces chafing. | --- ## Material Breakdown | Material | Pros | Cons | Ideal Use | |----------|------|------|------------| | **Cotton** | Soft, breathable, natural | Absorbs moisture, can shrink | Everyday, casual | | **Modal** | Smooth, moisture‑wicking, less pilling | Can be pricey | Sensitive skin, everyday | | **Bamboo** | Eco‑friendly, antibacterial, moisture‑wicking | Limited availability | Eco‑conscious shoppers | | **Polyester** | Durable, dries fast | Less breathable | Sports, travel | | **Nylon** | Lightweight, strong | Can feel slick | Performance wear | | **Spandex/Lycra** | Adds stretch, shape retention | Can degrade over time | All styles needing elasticity | | **Technical blends** | Advanced moisture control, anti‑odor | Often expensive | Athletes, hot climates | --- ## Final Tips 1. **Fit Matters** – A snug waistband should stay in place without digging into the skin. 2. **Check the Seam** – Flat‑lock seams reduce friction and prevent chafing. 3. **Try Before You Buy** – If possible, test a pair in-store or order from a retailer with a generous return policy. 4. **Layer Wisely** – For colder climates, consider thermal briefs or a lightweight thermal liner. 5. **Wash Properly** – Follow care instructions; most performance fabrics benefit from cold water and gentle cycles. --- ### Bottom Line - **Everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or briefs in cotton or modal. - **Active performance**: Compression shorts or performance boxer briefs. - **Travel & versatility**: Trunks or boxer briefs in quick‑dry fabrics. - **Special occasions**: Thongs or jockstraps only if you’re comfortable with minimal coverage. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, comfort preferences, and material sensitivities, and you’ll be set for any occasion!
